scenario: exibicao (-v2 display reference), Missions display bench
method: AffGame isolated at its real entry in between_frames(k); native run to 0x417B1C, then native run to 0x417D30 with recording-only hooks (routine entries and arguments, surface hash per tail segment, DGROUP/arena reads-before-write and writes, offscreen pixels written); exact entry state restored, the real AffGame continues.
routine_entry_format: [name, return_address, EAX, EDX, EBX, ECX, [4 stack words above the return address]]
touched_format: mask: 800x600 bytes (1 = written during the tail); values: checkpoint/end bytes of the written pixels in row-major order
blob_format: frames reference blobs by key; blobs[key] = base64(zlib(payload)); JSON payloads are compact UTF-8 JSON
representative: touched checkpoint/end values are stored for the first frame of each distinct HUD call sequence (routines blob, arguments included); every frame keeps their SHA-256
